caseNameFull: Abdul Samad v. Henry Behrandt, U. S. Marshal, etc.
summary: Appeal from the District Court of the United States for the Eastern District of Michigan.
attorneys: Mr. Hannis Taylor for appellant., Mr. William C. Herron with whom Mr. Assistant Attorney General Stewart and Mr. H. S. Bidgely were on the brief, for appellees.

opinions.text:
Per Curiam.

Dismissed for want of jurisdiction upon the authority of Brolan v. United States, 236 U. S. 216, 217-218; Sugarman v. United States, 249 U. S. 182, 185.
